notes: The 2025 Part B National Summary Data File is posted: the page was last modified 4 Sep 2026 and lists one ZIP, 2025-part-b-national-summary-data-file.zip-0 (1.6 MB). It lists no 2022–2024 files. I downloaded the ZIP with WebFetch and the tool saved it at C:\Users\palaz\.claude\projects\C--Users-palaz-OneDrive-Documents-ILMN-Claude-Code-Local-Folder--Build-thesis-scrape-sandbox\69752ffb-cfcb-491e-9800-ac0143840939\tool-results\webfetch-1791799266200-rr7bv3.zip. I could not read it. This session has no shell, so I could not unzip it, and Read and WebFetch cannot parse binary xlsx. The file names visible inside the ZIP include 'Y2025_24) Pathology.Lab Tests (P0000 - P9999).xlsx' and 'Y2025_32) Miscellaneous Codes.xlsx'. The CPT-style 0xxxU PLA and 81xxx codes are probably in a different sheet, but I did not confirm which one. I found no data for 0340U, 0364U, 0306U/0307U, 0425U/0426U, 81420, 81425–81427 or 0094U, so I report no figures and made no estimates. Next step: have an agent with a shell run `python -I` to unzip the saved file into a new empty directory and read the xlsx sheets with openpyxl or pandas. Filter on the HCPCS codes above and pull allowed services and allowed charges. Then compute y/y growth and implied Gb (WGS ≈100 Gb per test, MRD ≈10 Gb per test, both assumptions). Earlier years (2022–2024) are available only by emailing ipag_data_products@cms.hhs.gov, which is not suitable for this scrape. Prior-year ZIPs may still exist at the same URL pattern, for example /files/zip/2024-part-b-national-summary-data-file.zip, but I did not test that. The AMA click-through licence is the only gate, so no login is needed.

leads.name: CMS Part B National Summary Data File 2025 ZIP
leads.access: Public download (1.6 MB ZIP, AMA click-through). Already saved locally by WebFetch; needs a shell to unzip and parse.
leads.rationale: Allowed services by PLA and 81425–81427 code would give Medicare-wide counts for MRD, WGS and NIPT. That is a cleaner measure than the earlier partial Medicare-FFS volume findings (F651, F674, F675, F676, F720, F728).

leads.name: CMS Part B National Summary Data File: earlier years
leads.access: Page links only the 2025 file; earlier years were not found and are available only on request by email.
leads.rationale: A 2022–2024 series would be needed for the y/y growth comparison. Try the 2024 ZIP URL pattern, or the CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners 'by Geography and Service' dataset on data.cms.gov, which is a public API.
